title: Career Roadmap · Beautician
summary: A Beautician provides beauty and personal-care services such as skincare, facials, makeup, hair removal and basic beauty treatments, following hygiene and client-safety standards.

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Class 10 / 12 → Recognized beauty & wellness training → Practical experience → Beautician → Senior Beautician / Beauty Specialist / Salon Owner.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Any stream may be suitable; entry requirements depend on the course.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Biology, basic chemistry, communication and business studies, where available.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Skincare, makeup, nail care, hygiene, colour theory and customer service.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Hand coordination, attention to detail, consultation, sanitation and time management.

blocks.label: Entry routes
blocks.text: Short-term vocational courses, diploma programmes and apprenticeship-style practical training.

items.text: Diploma in Beauty & Wellness → Broad salon and beauty-service skills.
Cosmetology diploma → Beauty and personal-care techniques; scope varies by provider.
Certificate in Beautician / Beauty Therapy → Entry-level services, depending on training and employer requirements.
Makeup / Nail Technology / Skincare courses → Specialist service pathways.
Vocational qualification through an approved skill provider → Practical training aligned with the relevant job role.

blocks.label: Important
blocks.text: A beauty diploma does not authorize medical diagnosis or invasive medical procedures. Verify the course curriculum, practical hours, recognition and local safety rules.

blocks.label: Stage 1 — Foundation
blocks.text: Skin and hair basics, hygiene, client consultation and product knowledge.

blocks.label: Stage 2 — Technical skills
blocks.text: Facials, waxing, brows, manicure/pedicure and basic makeup.

blocks.label: Stage 3 — Practice
blocks.text: Supervised client services, sanitation routines, portfolio building and feedback.

blocks.label: Stage 4 — Career preparation
blocks.text: Service menu, pricing, customer retention and interview or business preparation.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: Skincare consultation form; bridal makeup portfolio; salon hygiene checklist; sample service menu and budget.

blocks.label: Training / skill ecosystem
blocks.text: B&WSSC-aligned training providers and approved practical-learning centres.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: Salons, spas, beauty studios, cosmetics retailers and bridal makeup teams.

blocks.label: Ideal experience areas
blocks.text: Facial services, makeup, waxing and brow services, nail care and client consultation.
Choose placements that include supervised practice, hygiene standards and genuine client-service experience. Internships and jobs are not guaranteed.
